description: POST /v1/messages with stream:true and thinking {type:adaptive, display:summarized} — a thinking block whose signature_delta arrives immediately before content_block_stop, then a text block.
note: With display:"omitted" no thinking_delta events are sent: the block opens, receives one signature_delta, and closes.
note_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking (retrieved 2026-09-03): 'When streaming with display: "omitted", no thinking_delta events are emitted. With display: "updates", only progress-update blocks stream thinking_delta events.'
display_default_scope: Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos Preview
display_default_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking (retrieved 2026-09-03), section 'Controlling thinking display': '"omitted": thinking blocks are returned with an empty thinking field. The signature field still carries the encrypted full thinking for multi-turn continuity (see Thinking encryption). This is the default on Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, and Claude Mythos Preview.'
display_default_note: Two revisions of this fixture were wrong about this list. The first asserted the default with no citation at all. The second (fact-check round 1) cited the page's 'thinking is already on and needs no configuration' sentence, which names only seven models and scopes thinking-being-on-by-default, not the display default -- so it dropped Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Opus 4.7. Corrected in fact-check round 2 against the authoritative 'Controlling thinking display' section, which names nine. On Opus 4.8 and Opus 4.7 thinking is OFF until thinking:{type:'adaptive'} is set, but once set, display still defaults to 'omitted' -- so a conformance case for those models must expect NO thinking_delta events unless it also sets display:'summarized'. 'summarized' is the default only on Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier.
display_summarized_default_scope: Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and earlier models
thinking_on_by_default_scope: Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Mythos Preview -- a DIFFERENT list from display_default_scope; do not conflate them
